$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-fieldset) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: A <fieldset> keeps its legend, description and fields as siblings: the 6 px and 20 px steps are margins (checked through the size), not one gap.

Header.$why: Figma groups the legend and description in a Header frame; the code has no wrapper (the legend must be the fieldset's first child). Their sizes and the 6 px step show in the set's height.
